reuse.why: Uses RSchedule's own byDayOfWeek filtering inside the shared recurConfigToRSchedule, which every recurrence consumer (parseRecurDate, getUpcomingDates, find-schedules) goes through, instead of adding new date loops.

duplication.why: The change is made once in the shared rule builder; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The tree names applyWeekendRule as 'the single definition of the weekend rule', yet the daily skip goes into recurrence generation, so the weekend rule is now split across two functions with no pointer from one to the other.

scope.why: One function changed, plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Short and effective, but the interval-multiple-of-7 'empty rule' trick (end before start) is a clever special case, and readers of applyWeekendRule will not see that daily schedules are handled elsewhere.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts recurConfigToRSchedule (daily case), used by every recurrence path; the move rule for other frequencies stays in applyWeekendRule
